description: This file defines the AsyncSimpleGrain class, a C# class implementing asynchronous methods for a grain in an Orleans-based distributed application. It includes methods for setting and getting values asynchronously, with simulated delays for testing.

classes.name: AsyncSimpleGrain
classes.description: A C# class representing an Orleans grain with asynchronous methods for setting and retrieving two integer values, including delay simulations for testing.

methods.name: GetAxB_Async
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the product of two integers, with a delay for testing.

methods.name: GetAxB_Async(int, int)
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the product of two provided integers, with a delay for testing.

methods.name: SetA_Async
methods.description: Asynchronously sets the value of A, with a delay for testing.

methods.name: SetB_Async
methods.description: Asynchronously sets the value of B, with a delay for testing.

methods.name: IncrementA_Async
methods.description: Asynchronously increments the value of A, with a delay for testing.

methods.name: GetA_Async
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the value of A, with a delay for testing.

methods.name: GetX
methods.description: Returns a task that will complete when SetX is called, providing the value set.

methods.name: SetX
methods.description: Sets the value of X and completes the task returned by GetX.
